title: FRANK channel content
description: CH-01 (FRANK-§8E). Frank-owned, surface-neutral content posted to a channel surface. The surface renders it; it never defines, approves, or attests it. Actions on a card are proposals: durable resolution arrives through an inbound event plus a FRANK command envelope (ADR-022). No channel SDK type participates in this schema (FRANK-§6).

contentId.description: Frank-side id for this content instance; doubles as the idempotency key for posting.

cellId.description: FRANK-§2.4. Every content instance is scoped to exactly one cell.

roomId.description: Frank room the content is associated with.

workItemId.description: FRANK work item the content is about, when it is about one.

actions.description: Actions offered on the card; empty when the content is informational. A tap relays an inbound event; it does not decide (ADR-022).

kind.description: v1 defines plain text blocks only; the envelope schema field pins the block set.

verb.description: FRANK command verb the interaction proposes (e.g. 'ready', 'cancel').
